item.title: [VERY INTERESTING NEWS] Toby Fox: "There will be no more wacky silly adventures in Chapter 6 and 7"
item.description:
https://www.gamesradar.com/games/rpg/deltarune-creator-toby-fox-says-there-are-no-more-wacky-silly-adventures-as-chapter-6-will-finally-deal-with-the-rpgs-main-mysteries/

>Fox writes in a new blog post: "Chapter 5 was a really fun chapter, and with that last big burst of craziness out of the way, I'm sure everybody is eager for Deltarune to start directly tackling the main mysteries of the game"

&g
